story.title: I founded Healio because too many people do not know what they may be entitled to.
paragraphs: As an insurance broker, I saw the same pattern for years: people with statutory health insurance go without dental treatment or postpone care because the costs put pressure on them. Meanwhile, possible health fund bonuses go unused.

With Healio, I created a system that gives you back control of your healthcare financing: independent, rational and understandable. A suitable plan can reimburse treatment costs; a health fund bonus may offset all or part of the premium.
That is why I combine independent insurance advice with a partner network in healthcare. Practices can provide neutral information; assessment, advice and insurance intermediation remain with Healio.
story.conclusion: My goal is a solution you understand and can use in everyday life.
story.founderImageAlt: Frank Steinfurt, founder and managing director of Healio GmbH

principles.title: Clarity starts before a policy is taken out.
principles.description: We do not measure good advice by the number of products. We measure it by whether a decision is suitable and remains easy to understand.

items.title: Needs before plans
items.text: We start with personal circumstances, desired benefits and budget — not with a product.

items.title: Independent advice
items.text: As an insurance broker, we are not tied to a single insurer. We explain the selection, conditions and limitations.

items.title: Understand the decision
items.text: We make reimbursement limits, health questions, waiting periods and bonus requirements visible.

items.title: Personal support
items.text: From the first assessment and application to later questions, Healio remains available.

impact.title: Make at least one area of cover financeable through a statutory health insurance bonus.
impact.description: We help people fund the premium for at least one area – outpatient, dental or hospital – as far as possible through their statutory health insurance bonus. We assess individually which protection genuinely fits.

impact.disclaimer: The benefits shown are not automatic. They depend, among other things, on the selected plan, insurability and the applicable insurance terms. A potential IKK bonus of EUR 700+ per year requires IKK classic membership and completion of the relevant bonus activities.
